prompt.en: You already have RM60. Monthly income is RM300 and expenses are RM240. How many full months are needed to reach at least RM300? No interest applies.
prompt.ms: Anda sudah mempunyai RM60. Pendapatan bulanan RM300 dan perbelanjaan RM240. Berapa bulan penuh diperlukan untuk mencapai sekurang-kurangnya RM300? Tiada faedah.

en: Calculate monthly savings first.
Subtract existing savings from the goal, divide by monthly savings and round up to a full month.
Monthly savings are RM60; 4 months are needed.
ms: Kira simpanan bulanan dahulu.
Tolak simpanan sedia ada daripada matlamat, bahagi dengan simpanan bulanan dan bundarkan ke atas kepada bulan penuh.
Simpanan bulanan RM60; 4 bulan diperlukan.

explanation.en: RM60 saved each month reaches at least RM300 after 4 full months.
explanation.ms: Simpanan RM60 setiap bulan mencapai sekurang-kurangnya RM300 selepas 4 bulan penuh.

prompt.en: Monthly income is RM500. Planned expenses are RM280 + RM90 + RM50. Find monthly savings.
prompt.ms: Pendapatan bulanan RM500. Perbelanjaan dirancang RM280 + RM90 + RM50. Cari simpanan bulanan.

en: A budget accounts for income and planned expenses.
Savings = income − total expenses.
The remaining amount is RM80.
ms: Belanjawan mengambil kira pendapatan dan perbelanjaan dirancang.
Simpanan = pendapatan − jumlah perbelanjaan.
Baki ialah RM80.

explanation.en: Income minus all planned expenses leaves RM80 for savings.
explanation.ms: Pendapatan ditolak semua perbelanjaan dirancang meninggalkan RM80 untuk simpanan.

prompt.en: Budget RM160: buy at least 2 food packs (RM20 each), 1 medical kits (RM30 each) and 1 lamp (RM15 each). Save at least RM30. Choose a feasible plan.
prompt.ms: Belanjawan RM160: beli sekurang-kurangnya 2 pek makanan (RM20 setiap satu), 1 kit perubatan (RM30 setiap satu) dan 1 lampu (RM15 setiap satu). Simpan sekurang-kurangnya RM30. Pilih pelan yang sesuai.

en: Meet essential needs before buying extras.
Check food × 20 + medical × 30 + lamps × 15 + savings ≤ budget.
One plan is 3 food, 1 medical, 2 lamps and RM40 savings.
ms: Penuhi keperluan asas sebelum membeli tambahan.
Semak makanan × 20 + perubatan × 30 + lampu × 15 + simpanan ≤ belanjawan.
Satu pelan ialah 3 makanan, 1 perubatan, 2 lampu dan simpanan RM40.

explanation.en: You met essential needs, protected savings and stayed within budget. Several plans can be valid; unspent money is allowed.
explanation.ms: Anda memenuhi keperluan asas, menjaga simpanan dan mematuhi belanjawan. Beberapa pelan boleh sah; baki wang dibenarkan.
